effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 2 of your opponent's Digimon with equal or fewer digivolution cards than this Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have a Tamer, unsuspend this Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-5＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 5 memory.)
xros_req: [Digivolve] While you have 2 or fewer security cards, [Gabumon]: Cost 3
